items.title: Packing a Clear Document Case
items.alt: Two older adults pack clipped paper packets into a transparent case on a low wooden bench.
items.description: The seated man lowers the grouped papers into the open box while the standing woman holds its clear lid. His olive shirt and her burgundy sweater contrast with the pale document edges and dark trouser fabric.

items.title: A Classroom Mock Election
items.alt: A teacher supervises two children beside a cardboard Class Vote box and a chalkboard of simple shapes.
items.description: One child places a folded practice paper into the small cardboard box while the other waits with a separate sheet. The teal-dressed teacher stands behind them beside a circle, triangle and square on the chalkboard.

items.title: Painting a Vote Sign
items.alt: A red-haired man in green overalls paints a large navy Vote sign supported on wooden trestles.
items.description: The brush meets the final pale letter near a small paint pot in his other hand. A cloth hangs over one trestle beneath the weathered sign, with his work boots fully visible beside it.

items.title: Arriving with an Umbrella
items.alt: A woman in a burgundy raincoat closes a teal umbrella beside a doorway with a Vote sign.
items.description: Yellow boots stand on the small wooden threshold below the open glazed door. A hanging navy placard and a leafy plant in a ribbed metal pot frame the compact entrance scene.

items.title: A Break for Poll Workers
items.alt: Two older Poll Worker volunteers share tea at a small round table with a thermos and notebook.
items.description: The woman in a sage cardigan raises a cream mug across from a man in a burgundy waistcoat holding a blue cup. Their plain blue lanyards and simple folding chairs keep the scene informal and specific.

items.title: Packing I Voted Sticker Rolls
items.alt: Two rolls of I Voted stickers unwind beside an open navy pouch and a small wooden squeegee.
items.description: Red-and-blue oval sticker faces repeat along the pale backing strips outside the canvas pouch. A visible zip edge and cream fabric lining contrast with the black edge of the wooden tool.
